from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import calendar

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    # Parse the input date
    date_obj = datetime.strptime(day, "%Y-%m-%d")
    year = date_obj.year
    month = date_obj.month
    dom = date_obj.day
    
    # Check if the input day is the last day of its month
    last_day_of_month = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    is_last_day = (dom == last_day_of_month)
    
    # Calculate target month and year
    target_month = month + n
    target_year = year
    
    # Adjust year and month if needed
    while target_month > 12:
        target_month -= 12
        target_year += 1
    while target_month < 1:
        target_month += 12
        target_year -= 1
    
    # Determine the day in the target month
    last_day_of_target = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
    
    if is_last_day:
        # If original day was last day of month, use last day of target month
        target_day = last_day_of_target
    else:
        # Otherwise, use the same day, or last day if target month is too short
        target_day = min(dom, last_day_of_target)
    
    # Create and return the new date
    result_date = datetime(target_year, target_month, target_day)
    return result_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
